verdict.rationale: Thoropass is a SaaS compliance platform, so publishing a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec is a fair question for it. The pack documents only an MCP server and a help-center llms.txt index. Neither is a machine-readable API specification, and no OpenAPI, Swagger or public API reference is mentioned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
